name: Punjab Police Emergency
description: Police assistance for immediate threats, violence, assault, and situations where a person may be in danger.
when_to_recommend: Someone is threatening to kill me
I think I might seriously hurt someone
availability: Emergency service; verify current local availability

name: Umang Pakistan
description: Mental health support contact listed in WHO resources for Pakistan. Confirm current availability and suitability for suicide crises before deployment.

name: Punjab Women Helpline
description: Punjab government helpline for women's concerns, including domestic violence, workplace harassment, discrimination and related legal guidance.
when_to_recommend: I am being harassed at work
I need guidance about my rights
availability: 24/7 according to the official Punjab government listing
